selected_matrix_policy: Use the planned reportable repetition when available. Reddit multi-agent uses the only reportable run, an explicitly unplanned robustness repetition, because the planned attempt was non-reportable after a schema-contract failure.

cells.primary_failure: dilution_pct emitted as a decimal fraction; the memo also discarded the net-cash position and disagreed with the valuation handoff.
The valuation agent emitted dilution as a decimal fraction and the memo propagated the same wrong unit perfectly.

cells.stateful_transition: The v2 amendment corrected round-1 share-scale errors and produced a perfect final workflow.

cells.primary_failure: The memo overrode correct valuation handoffs, replacing 1463.6 million USD and 7.8823 percent with 1500.0 million USD and 8.08 percent.
The valuation agent emitted dilution as 0.0788 rather than about 7.884 percentage points and the memo propagated it exactly.
The generalist calculated gross proceeds as 862.411264 million USD instead of 863.112064 million USD and propagated the error to the memo.
The valuation agent introduced gross-proceeds and post-money arithmetic errors after the amendment and the memo propagated both.

dominant_failure_families: arithmetic drift after a filing amendment
downstream memo overriding a correct handoff

main_observations: Evidence freshness was not the dominant bottleneck: all selected cells revised the four artifacts and left no stale v1 artifact.
Perfect coordination did not imply enterprise validity when agents shared the same wrong value.
Architecture effects were case-dependent: the generalist was uniquely successful on CoreWeave, while isolated departments were uniquely successful on Rubrik.
A state update can either repair an earlier error, as in CoreWeave generalist, or create a new failure after a perfect first round, as in Rubrik generalist and multi-agent.
The identical Rubrik gross-proceeds error in generalist and multi-agent runs suggests a model-level arithmetic failure that is not specific to one orchestration design.
claim_boundary: This is a descriptive pilot matrix for one free model and mostly one repetition per cell. Reddit multi-agent comes from an unplanned robustness repetition. Means and success rates are descriptive only; repeated preregistered runs and uncertainty intervals are required before paper-grade comparative claims.
